claims.claim: Kolibri-1 has 78,103,074,560 total and 3,457,573,120 active parameters, 384 routed experts with top-6 routing plus one shared expert, and 50 layers.
Kolibri-1 weights are released under Apache 2.0, with rights applying only to the weights and configuration files and not to code, architecture, parameter settings or training methods.

Kolibri's EU AI Act public training-content summary lists Gemma-4-26B-A4B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.8-27B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2-fp8 and Kimi-K2.6 as models used to generate synthetic training data.
The model card states Kolibri's training data contains material generated with Chinese language models known to carry political bias, and that data was filtered for such bias.
For SFT Aleph Alpha generated 174B tokens of synthetic data inside a 268B-token SFT mix.
English Common Crawl was rephrased with Gemma-4-26B-A4B, German web data with Mistral-NeMo-12B, and Qwen3-32B served as an LLM judge for quality-classifier labels.
Pre-training used 768 NVIDIA B200 GPUs for 21 days; total compute 6.4e23 FLOPs and about 950 MWh.
Aleph Alpha's benchmark of 967 politically sensitive prompts found six Chinese models answered only 17 to 41 percent of prompts in a balanced way.
Nemotron Cascade 2, with roughly 3.5k of 9.3M SFT chat rows carrying CCP talking points, was flagged on 17 percent of prompts.
Kolibri scores 75.5 overall EN and 70.8 overall DE on Aleph Alpha's harness versus 80.2 and 79.9 for dense Qwen3.8 27B.
Nemotron-CC-v2.1 contains about 2,448.5B synthetic tokens out of 2,544.8B generated with Qwen3-30B-A3B.
Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1 has 24,602,969 of 25,659,642 rows generated by DeepSeek-R1-0528 and 1,056,673 by Qwen3-235B-A22B.
Kimi-K2.6's modified MIT license requires prominent display of 'Kimi K2.6' for commercial products above 100M monthly active users or $20M monthly revenue.
Z.ai's terms of service bar using its models or model-generated content to train external models without authorization.
AI Act Article 53(2) exempts open-source GPAI models from technical documentation duties but not from the copyright policy and the public training-content summary.
The AI Act presumes systemic risk above 10^25 training FLOPs; Kolibri's 6.4e23 is 6.4 percent of that threshold.
NIST CAISI found DeepSeek models echoed four times as many inaccurate and misleading CCP narratives as U.S. reference models.
The subliminal-learning paper did not observe trait transmission when teacher and student had different base models.
Cohere and Aleph Alpha signed a definitive business combination agreement on 2026-09-16, with the combined company operating as Cohere and the deal subject to regulatory approval.
Aleph Alpha's 2023 'more than $500M' round broke down into EUR 110M equity, EUR 300M research funding and EUR 60M order commitments.
Aleph Alpha says a 123B variant handled only 3 concurrent 256k-token queries on two H100s, while the 78B handles 18 and decodes 28% faster.
Aleph Alpha's German reasoning SFT pipeline used several unnamed open-source teacher models; a reasoning prefill kept 97% of traces German versus 67% with a system prompt.
Kolibri's model card recommends serving at or below 262,144 tokens; 1,048,576 is reached by extrapolation.
Kolibri's comparators date from spring 2026 and exclude GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, Qwen3.8 MoE and MiMo-V2.6-Pro.
Aleph Alpha is listed as a signatory of the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice; Zhipu, Moonshot and Alibaba are not.
